reason: The revised evaluator journey makes substantial, verifiable improvements: storage access is guarded, backup claims follow exact content signatures, divergent drafts pause for comparison/download/choice, and written evaluation review receives keyboard focus before locking. Group Case accepts observation-only notes and presents database-owned validity, minimum observations, required criteria and weighted coverage; My work no longer calls these editable observations immutable completions. The supplied mobile homepage is coherent with Precision Instrument, clearly states the no-fee semester offer and labels partnerships honestly. Application confirmation accurately discloses identifying original-resume access. However, Group Case still has an unbounded save path that can strand subsequent evidence during a service stall. That directly undermines my service-failure task and prevents world-class agreement; I recommend holding the consequential evaluator release until this path is repaired and checked. Approved project proof, membership workload facts and hosted authenticated acceptance also remain absent. This is an independent simulated AI source/artifact assessment, not observed human task success or provider integration acceptance.

findings.evidence: save waits for inflight.current[applicationId] at line 149, then awaits retryOnNetworkError(authorizedFetch(...)) at 157-161 and response.json() at 162 without a deadline. client-fetch.ts:authorizedFetch/retryOnNetworkError supplies no deadline; retries only follow rejection. A never-settling request or body therefore never reaches catch/finally. Later saves for that applicant wait behind the same promise. Retry/copy guidance at roster lines 434-439 renders only for error/hint, while save sets saving. Existing group-case-evidence.spec.ts covers settled failures and delayed-then-released responses, not a permanent stall. This is a source-derived failure path, not a reproduced hosted incident.
findings.userImpact: An evaluator can remain at Saving indefinitely with no confirmed receipt or reachable save recovery; later notes and ratings cannot persist for that applicant even when other interactions work. Reloading risks the in-memory evidence.
findings.suggestedFix: Bound the complete request and response-body lifecycle and expose explicit unconfirmed-state copy/recovery. Preserve the latest payload and serialization safeguards; account for a timed-out request potentially committing before replay. Add focused never-settling request/body checks showing recovery becomes available and later evidence is not silently blocked.
